basic_profile.bio: Avid Pokémon Go player and outdoor enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. I've been exploring the world with my trusty Pokémon buddies since launch day. When I'm not out catching 'em all, I work as a UX designer, blending creativity with usability. I love hiking the Pacific Northwest trails and occasionally dabble in web design projects. My online hours are mostly evenings and weekends, as I'm often out and about during the day. I enjoy connecting with fellow trainers and sharing tips. Currently in a relationship with a fellow Pokémon Go enthusiast, and we often team up for raids.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid background in UX design, gained through a combination of formal education and hands-on experience in the tech industry. My passion for Pokémon Go has made me quite knowledgeable about game mechanics, community events, and strategies, mostly through self-teaching and engagement with online forums.
